verdict: Most remediation is substantive. Do not close findings 03/04/08; three existing-scope residuals were independently reproduced in five cases. W10 remains unstarted.

一致但异常继续进入安全核查；跳过/陈旧比较区分处理，有针对性集成回归；仍非临床准确性验证。
可信研究法域、上游unknown继承、服务端数据分类及limited/validated=false已落实。
事件事实/重复实例与显式相关历史分开，有多事件、历史相关事实和空实例的回归。

forward_regressions: False parent prerequisite and true parent exception suppress the dependent child obligation.
Unknown ancestor applicability stays unknown in the child.
Sibling branches with equal intervals but distinct conditions are not silently merged.
An applicable obligation outside its window still reports out_of_window; do not mask real deviations.

observations.expected_correct_behavior: The child obligation inherits the parent's false prerequisite or effective waiver.
The child obligation inherits the parent's false prerequisite or effective waiver.

remaining.required_fix: Restrict center adoption/default selection to explicit same-lineage project versions; independent site SOP/rules must participate or surface a conflict, never silently erase a project rule just because rule_key matches.
forward_regressions: Shared project version retains distinct center adoption dates.
Independent site document with same key cannot remove project requirement.
A weaker/incompatible site requirement surfaces both sources and unresolved impact.
No latest/strictest/center-priority shortcut resolves a true conflict.

observations.expected_correct_behavior: Independent project requirements remain or an explicit source conflict is raised; a site document cannot silently waive them.

remaining.required_fix: A succeeded job must return its existing result before reading/inference/persistence. Explicit retry may safely requeue an expired running lease, fencing its old attempt; protect live leases and preserve original candidates/reviews.
forward_regressions: Completed redelivery has zero additional provider calls, rows, revisions or completion audits.
The public retry endpoint recovers an expired running lease; a live lease remains protected.
A late result from an obsolete lease cannot overwrite the active attempt.
Recovery and repeat delivery do not duplicate observations or lose CRA corrections.

observations.expected_correct_behavior: A repeated delivery of a succeeded job returns the existing result without inference, duplicate rows, or another completion audit.
An explicitly retried job whose lease expired can be safely requeued after fencing the old attempt; an unexpired active lease stays protected.
